name: VIP-Grinders Leaderboards
author: VIP-Grinders.com

sections.description:
This plugin enables you to seamlessly integrate VIP-Grinders.com leaderboards into your website — no coding required.

Key Features

  • Simple integration with no programming knowledge needed
  • Choose from predefined color schemes
  • Fully mobile-responsive
  • Flexible style customization to match your brand
  • Access to exclusive rake races, chases, and leaderboards
  • Option to request custom-built leaderboards tailored to your needs

Short Description

This plugin enables you to seamlessly integrate VIP-Grinders.com leaderboards into your website — no coding required.

External services

This plugin integrates with the VIP-Grinders.com API to retrieve live leaderboard data. It provides access to both the currently active leaderboards and detailed information for individual leaderboards, including player names, points, prizes, and player rankings. This information is required to render the leaderboard table on your site.

To display a specific leaderboard, the plugin sends the leaderboard ID and display parameters to the API endpoint.

The service is provided by VIP-Grinders.com, a leading poker and casino affiliate, with exclusive promotions and bonus codes. Please review our Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation: Just add the plugin in WordPress via “Plugins” -> “Add new”. Or upload the plugin to the plugin folder and active the plugin.
